verdicts.reason: A: the headline and logo hold up, but the venue address is set larger than the date panel and wraps awkwardly ('Gallery, 4 / Kiln Lane'). The date panel's hours line is tiny, and the EXHIBITION label has been moved under the image at the bottom left, so it no longer reads before the title. B: the address now sits above the headline, which breaks the reading order. The EXHIBITION label and the Monograph logo have shrunk to illegible specks, which is a brand failure, and the date panel is jammed against the image bottom with tiny hours text. A keeps the brand and hierarchy better.
